texts.value: Component of the lipopolysaccharide (LPS) transport (Lpt) pathway that promotes efficient assembly of the outer membrane LPS translocon (LptDE) by the BAM complex (PubMed:37821449). Facilitates oxidative maturation of LptD by stabilizing a conformation of the LPS translocon in which LptD can efficiently acquire native disulfide bonds, thereby activating the LPS translocon (PubMed:37821449). Might stabilize an active conformation of the LPS translocon by mimicking its natural substrate (PubMed:37821449)

Interacts with the outer membrane embedded portion of the LPS translocon formed by LptD and LptE (LptDE) (PubMed:37821449). LptM binds to sites in both LptD and LptE, forming a 1:1:1 heterotrimeric complex (PubMed:37821449)

Inactivation of the gene impairs LptD oxidative maturation and causes the accumulation of intermediate oxidation forms (PubMed:37821449). It prolongs the residence of LptD and LptE at the BAM complex (PubMed:37821449)
